bravo49f.title: Hohner: Bravo I 49 F
bravo49f.scope: Free-bass beginner instrument developed with music teachers and framed against didactic standards; manufacturer statement.

bravo_series.title: Hohner: Bravo Series
bravo_series.scope: Bravo family designed for beginners; 49F identified as the free-bass route.

distinctions: Free-bass is treated as a different left-hand system, not as a prestige upgrade.
Teacher-linked design is bounded to Hohner's statement and does not establish a universal school standard.
The required free-bass layout and range must come from the student's curriculum before model selection.
